summary: Tested Calendar Enhancement features (iteration 110). All 10 features working correctly. Backend APIs (POST /api/crm/v2/activities with due_date, GET /api/crm/users) pass all tests. Frontend calendar has Add Event button, type filters, staff filter with 'My Calendar' default and 'All Staff' option for managers.

feature_1_post_activities_with_due_date.details: POST /api/crm/v2/activities correctly accepts due_date field and returns activity with owner_id set to current user

feature_2_get_crm_users.details: GET /api/crm/users returns team members with id, full_name, role. Craig has manager role.

feature_3_add_event_button_header.details: Add Event button (data-testid='calendar-add-event-btn') present in calendar header

feature_4_add_event_day_hover.details: '+' button (data-testid='add-event-day-{dateStr}') appears on day cell hover

feature_5_add_event_dialog.details: Add Event dialog (data-testid='add-calendar-event-dialog') opens with type selector, subject input, date input, details textarea. All event types available: meeting, call, email, task, note, visit

feature_6_type_filter_buttons.details: All 7 type filter buttons found: call, email, meeting, task, note, visit, engineer. Toggle on/off works correctly.

feature_7_staff_filter_dropdown.details: Staff filter dropdown (data-testid='calendar-staff-filter') present with 'My Calendar' as default value

feature_8_all_staff_option_for_managers.details: Craig (manager role) sees 'All Staff' option in staff filter dropdown

feature_9_individual_team_members.details: Staff filter shows 3 individual team members: CRM Admin, Master Admin, Craig Henshall

feature_10_events_filtered_by_owner.details: My Calendar shows 56 events, All Staff shows 132 events - filtering by owner_id works correctly

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 110 tested calendar enhancements. All features working: Add Event button, type filters (7 types), staff filter with My Calendar default and All Staff for managers. Backend APIs for activities and users working correctly. Demo tour modal blocks navigation - need to close it first (click X button or press Escape).
